mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_candidate_approval WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND candidate_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}

SELECT d.document_id,d.published_version AS version,d.published_generation AS index_generation,d.published_job_id AS job_id, j.processor_version,j.batch_digest,j.content_hash AS source_hash FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.job_id=d.published_job_id AND j.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND j.owner_id=d.owner_id AND j.document_id=d.document_id AND j.document_version=d.published_version AND j.index_generation=d.published_generation WHERE d.tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND d.owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND d.document_id=#{id} AND d.lifecycle='ACTIVE' AND d.purpose='STANDARD' AND d.lifecycle_ready=TRUE AND j.status='READY' AND j.batch_digest IS NOT NULL
